title: Khlea Stuffed Potatoes
description: A twist on classic stuffed potatoes, using traditional moroccan flavors and khlea for a hearty meal.

ingredients.name: Potatoes
ingredients.notes: Choose high-starch potatoes for fluffiest results

ingredients.name: Khlea
ingredients.notes: Chop khlea into small pieces for easier cooking

ingredients.name: Moroccan Spices
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of cumin, coriander, and paprika for authentic flavor

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.notes: Use high-quality butter for best flavor

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Add salt to taste, but be mindful of khlea's natural saltiness

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground black pepper for best flavor

instructions: Pierce potatoes with a fork to allow steam to escape.
Rub potatoes with butter and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake potatoes for 45-50 minutes, or until tender.
While potatoes are baking, heat khlea in a pan over medium heat.
Add Moroccan spices to khlea and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Once potatoes are done, slice them in half lengthwise.
Scoop out some of the potato flesh to make room for the khlea mixture.
Fill the potatoes with the khlea mixture and top with additional butter if desired.
Return the potatoes to the oven and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the filling is heated through.
